inputs.text: South African actress Terry Pheto is being linked to alleged financial misconduct involving the National Lotteries Commission for R20.56 million in this SIU probe, with fresh details presented during the briefing to the National Assembly’s Portfolio Committee on Trade, Industry and Competition on Tuesday, 24 March 2026. This kind of scandal at a public funding body highlights the deeper structural failures in our institutions, where resources that could support community upliftment and reduce inequality are instead caught up in misconduct that hits the most vulnerable hardest. It shows the urgent need for real institutional reform to tackle these patterns of mismanagement and ensure public money actually serves social justice rather than reinforcing existing disparities.
